g.text: Study 9 — Who initiates reorganization? Talk-time explains it; a weak, definition-dependent drift toward the facilitator

Figure 9. (A) Initiation lift (init_primary definition): the least-talkative member (S5) initiates far more than their talk-time predicts in both teams; the facilitator's lift is close to 1 (roughly proportional to talk-time). (B)

Facilitator-initiated share rises modestly with week in team B (τ=+.41, p=.02) but not team A (n.s.); pooled τ=+.27, p=.03 — a weak, definition-dependent trend (null for the init_question definition), reported honestly, not as a
